Axiom:
Measure CONTRACT coverage, not line coverage. Mandatory minimum per public method/function: 1. ≥1 happy-path scenario. 2. ≥1 boundary scenario (boundary value, edge of input domain) when contract has boundary semantics. 3. ≥1 failure-path scenario per declared `@throws` / rejected promise.
Ignored: thin pass-through wrappers without hidden policy, type-only constructs, dead branches excluded by `AX_MINIMAL_ERROR_SURFACE` in coding-rules.
